results.title: Guard
results.overview: A young lifeguard finds herself isolated from her peers as she struggles with the weight of mortality.

results.title: The Undertaker 2: Afterlife
results.original_title: สัปเหร่อ 2 โลกหลังความตาย
results.overview: Following the passing of Baikaow and Sak, life in the village slowly returns to normal. This calm is disrupted when Grandma Joy is suddenly struck by lightning and miraculously revives.

results.title: Semicolon
results.overview: Two old friends reconnect after the unexpected death of their best friend.

results.title: A Beautiful Day
results.overview: Tommaso, a single father of four, has shut himself off from the world. When his daughters push him to start over, he meets Lara — a brilliant, captivating woman. But both carry secrets that could change everything.

results.title: Ketenpere: Dalavere
results.overview: In the sequel, Kalender has fulfilled his biggest dream: founding a film company. His new goal is to team up with Vefa, who trapped him in first film, to retrieve the gold from Feza, a wealthy businessman obsessed with aliens.

results.title: Love on a Tightrope
results.overview: In 1960s Spain, legendary trapecist Pinito del Oro hires young poet Natalia Sosa Ayala to help with her memoirs, sparking a profound emotional bond between them. Through historical events, intimate encounters, and decades of letters, their admiration, affection, and creative passion intertwine. The story moves between memory, desire, and imagination, showing how these two artists influence each other’s quests for freedom, artistic expression, and recognition. Rooted in real moments but told with a dreamlike, imaginative lens, it explores what might have been between them, revealing a tender, evocative tale of connection, longing, and the courage to defy societal constraints.

results.title: The Dashed Lines
results.overview: Bea is a middle-aged woman going through divorce. Denís is a young trans man who breaks into her house. Rather than turning him in to the police, she decides to spend the next few days getting to know him.

results.title: Hummingbird
results.overview: Set in Queens in 2009, this coming-of-age story follows a teen struggling between her overbearing, religious mother and the truth she can no longer deny.

results.title: decay
results.overview: I am grateful to the Chinese for the invention of gunpowder — it feels as if they made it for me. Its discovery happened by accident, originally conceived as a way to ward off evil spirits. This film begins in China, then moves to an event in Cartagena, and ends centuries later in Bogotá.

results.title: Love In Separate Beds
results.overview: She hates men, he hates complications - but after one passionate night ties them together, these two irreconcilable opposites are forced to coexist... working at the same school, with a baby on the way! Can a staunch feminist and an oblivious chauvinist find common ground?

results.title: Princess and the Pickle Boys
results.overview: When a young princess disappears into a mysterious and dangerous forest, a courageous group of boys known as the Pickleboys embark on an unforgettable adventure to rescue her.

results.title: 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero
results.overview: After the 9/11 attacks, after the smoke was gone, after the rubble cleared away, New Yorkers had a city to rebuild. In response to fast-tracked redevelopment plans, more than 5,000 people gathered in the largest town hall in American history. They came to vote on the city’s six proposals for rebuilding Ground Zero. But instead, the people rejected the top down approach and successfully charted a new path forward. Their work determined what is at Ground Zero today. And their story is an example of what democracy can look like.

results.title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
results.overview: When a dedicated young designer at a crossroads reluctantly follows her sister home to the nostalgic heart of the Ozarks for Christmas, she finds herself rediscovering not only her family’s legacy for commitment to craft, but also the quiet faith and purpose she has lost in the rush of modern life. With the help of Paul, Clara will reconnect with work rooted in care and community.

results.title: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares
results.overview: Annapurna: Dreams and Nightmares is a 2026 documentary film by Thin Air Cinematics that challenges the traditional "man-conquers-mountain" story by exploring high-altitude mountaineering through failure, fear and human obsession  Filmed over 13 years, spanning 6 expeditions on 5 different climbing routes, this deeply personal documentary is an unflinching exploration into the life and mind of a high-altitude climber.  What begins with a dream becomes obsession, and ultimately a reckoning with why we climb in the first place.

results.title: Accept Our Sincere Apologies
results.overview: In a decadent Venetian hotel, general manager Eva is drawn to the mysterious Contessa. Once a sanctuary from the outside world, the hotel has become a haunting cage, and both women long to escape. A hypnotic gothic fantasy that seduces and unsettles.

results.title: Where No One Can Find Her
results.original_title: Where No One Can Find Her
results.overview: When her teen daughter Izzy is kidnapped and buried alive, Jamie and her ex-husband must put aside their differences and work together to raise a massive ransom and save Izzy from a premature grave.

results.title: Das gewisse Etwas
results.overview: After a jewelry heist, a father and son are on the run from the police. They find refuge in a coach full of people with disabilities who are on their way to a holiday camp in the Alpine foothills with their carer. Without further ado, they pretend to be a missing fellow passenger and his carer.
